# WoW Train (glosx.app)

> Free train trip planner for Europe, Japan and China. Describe a trip in plain language and get a rail itinerary with routes, journey times, operators and booking links. Comprehensive route guides in 8 languages, plus open-data timetable pages built from official rail operator data. No account, no signup. Independent project by GLOSX, not affiliated with any rail operator.

WoW Train is a website, not a mobile app. Bookings are completed on partner platforms (Omio for Europe, Klook for Japan and China); WoW Train never processes payments and earns an affiliate commission at no extra cost to the traveller. Prices shown on the site are indicative; the final fare is the one on the partner site for the chosen date.

## AI & Machine Learning Integration (WebMCP)
- [WebMCP AI Catalog](https://glosx.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Structured metadata catalog for AI agents and LLMs to discover WoW Train tools and affiliate booking endpoints.

## Planner and Route Guides
- [AI trip planner](https://glosx.app/): describe a trip in plain language and get each leg with journey time and a booking link; Europe, Japan and China modes.
- [All route guides](https://glosx.app/rutas/): index of route guides covering Europe, Japan (grouped by region), and China high-speed corridors (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Xi'an). Each guide includes journey times, operating stations, and FAQ.
- Featured Corridors & Hubs:
  - Europe: [Trains from London](https://glosx.app/trains-from-london/), [Trains from Paris](https://glosx.app/trains-from-paris/), [UK to Europe](https://glosx.app/trains-from-uk-to-europe/), [France to Spain](https://glosx.app/trains-from-france-to-spain/), [France to Italy](https://glosx.app/trains-from-france-to-italy/), [Germany to Italy](https://glosx.app/trains-from-germany-to-italy/).
  - Japan: [Tokyo to Kyoto](https://glosx.app/rutas/tokyo-kyoto/), [Tokyo to Osaka](https://glosx.app/rutas/tokyo-osaka/), [Tokyo to Kanazawa](https://glosx.app/rutas/tokyo-kanazawa/), [Osaka to Hiroshima](https://glosx.app/rutas/osaka-hiroshima/).
  - China: [Beijing to Shanghai](https://glosx.app/rutas/beijing-shanghai/), [Shanghai to Hangzhou](https://glosx.app/rutas/shanghai-hangzhou/), [Guangzhou to Hong Kong](https://glosx.app/rutas/guangzhou-hong-kong/), [Chengdu to Chongqing](https://glosx.app/rutas/chengdu-chongqing/).

## Open-Data Timetables & Official Showcases
Calculated by glosx.app from official open GTFS/timetable data; each page states its source, method, and a CSV download. The combined dataset (Switzerland, Austria, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Spain) is published on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23827431
- [Trains in Switzerland](https://glosx.app/swiss-trains/): connections from opentransportdata.swiss (SBB). WoW Train is officially featured as a showcase on [Open Transport Data Switzerland Showcase](https://data.opentransportdata.swiss/en/showcase/wow-train).
- [Trains in Austria](https://glosx.app/austria-trains/): from ÖBB open data.
- [Trains in Spain](https://glosx.app/horarios-trenes-espana/): from Renfe open data.
- [Trains in Norway](https://glosx.app/norway-trains/): from Entur open data.
- [Trains in Sweden](https://glosx.app/sweden-trains/): from Trafiklab open data.
- [Trains in Finland](https://glosx.app/finland-trains/): from Digitraffic open data.

## Country Train Guides (Operators, Train Types & Main Routes)
- [Trains in Germany](https://glosx.app/germany-trains/): Deutsche Bahn, ICE, and regional trains.
- [Trains in Spain](https://glosx.app/spain-trains/): Renfe AVE, Avlo, Ouigo, and Iryo.
- [Trains in Italy](https://glosx.app/italy-trains/): Trenitalia Frecciarossa, Italo, and regional trains.
- [Trains in France](https://glosx.app/france-trains/): TGV INOUI, OUIGO, Intercités, and TER.
- [Trains in China](https://glosx.app/china-trains/): G and D high-speed trains, passport ticketing, and major stations.
- [Trains in the United States](https://glosx.app/usa-trains/): Amtrak corridors, Brightline in Florida and long-distance trains, with 260 routes and timetable data from the official GTFS feeds

## Languages
Available in 8 languages with dedicated localized paths: English, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, and more. Every route guide and core section is accessible in all supported languages.
